hook: Thomas Wolf trained as a physicist, not a computer scientist, earning a PhD in statistical and quantum physics before spending five years as a patent attorney in Paris. He taught himself deep learning in 2015 and 2016 and used it to co-found Hugging Face, then helped build the Transformers library that became the standard interface to pretrained language models across the field. As the company's Chief Science Officer he has also driven its open-science side, including the BigScience workshop that produced the BLOOM model. In September 2026, Hugging Face agreed to be acquired by NVIDIA in a deal reported near thirteen billion dollars, a turn Wolf described on X as an outcome nobody at the company anticipated back in 2016.
name: Thomas Wolf

quote.text: To create an Einstein in a data center, we don't just need a system that knows all the answers, but rather one that can ask questions nobody else has thought of or dared to ask.
quote.context: From a TechCrunch interview with Thomas Wolf about the limits of current AI research, March 2025

moniker: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face

secondary.name: Fortune, NVIDIA acquisition of Hugging Face, September 2026
TechCrunch, Hugging Face Series D, August 2023

timeline.event: Leaves patent law and begins consulting for AI and machine learning startups while self-teaching deep learning
timeline.impact: Marks his transition from physics and law into machine learning

timeline.event: Co-founds Hugging Face in New York with Clement Delangue and Julien Chaumond
timeline.impact: Starts the company that would become a central hub for open-source machine learning

timeline.event: Co-authors the paper documenting the open-source Transformers library at the ACL conference's demo track
timeline.impact: Formalizes and publicizes the library that became a standard tool across NLP research

timeline.event: Leads the BigScience research workshop to its release of the BLOOM language model
timeline.impact: Demonstrates that a large language model can be built openly and collaboratively rather than behind closed doors

timeline.event: Hugging Face raises a $235 million Series D round in August, reaching a $4.5 billion valuation
timeline.impact: Cements the company's position as a well-funded center of open-source AI infrastructure

timeline.event: Hugging Face agrees to be acquired by NVIDIA for a reported approximately $12.9 billion, announced September 3
timeline.impact: Marks the largest outcome yet for an open-source AI infrastructure company

quick_facts: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face since its founding in 2016
PhD in statistical and quantum physics from Sorbonne University and ESPCI Paris, plus a law degree from Pantheon-Sorbonne University
Worked five years as a patent attorney at Cabinet Plasseraud before moving into machine learning around 2015
Co-authored the open-source Transformers library and the O'Reilly book Natural Language Processing with Transformers
Led the BigScience workshop that produced the openly released BLOOM language model
Hugging Face agreed to an approximately $12.9 billion acquisition by NVIDIA, announced September 3, 2026

achievements.title: Co-founded Hugging Face
achievements.impact: Built, with Clement Delangue and Julien Chaumond, what grew into a leading open-source hub for machine learning models, reported at 18 million individual users and 200,000 enterprise clients at the time of its 2026 NVIDIA acquisition.

achievements.title: Co-created the Transformers library
achievements.impact: Helped build and document the open-source library, described in the team's 2020 ACL paper, that standardized programmatic access to pretrained transformer models across the research and industry community.

achievements.title: Led BigScience and BLOOM
achievements.impact: Directed the open-science workshop that produced BLOOM, a large multilingual language model trained collaboratively across institutions and released openly rather than kept proprietary.

achievements.title: Directed Hugging Face's move into robotics and science tooling
achievements.impact: Steered the company's open-source projects, including LeRobot and the Reachy Mini robot, and its AI-for-science collaborations, according to his own site.
